newsitem.title: USA: Maine Yankee votes to close 910 MW nuclear plant.
newsitem.headline: Maine Yankee votes to close 910 MW nuclear plant.

text.p: Maine Yankee's board of directors voted Wednesday to shut down the troubled Maine Yankee nuclear power plant in Wiscasset, Maine.

"(The) board...voted unanimously today to permanently close the...nuclear reactor after concluding that the present owners could not operate the plant economically," the company said in a statement issued shortly after the vote.

Maine Yankee is 38 percent owned by Central Maine Power Co, 20 percent each by New England Electric System and Northeast Utilities, seven percent by Bangor Hydro-Electric Co, five percent by Maine Public Service Co and 10 percent by other New England utilities.

The move was widely expected by industry analysts following the board's failure to find a buyer for the 910 megawatt (MW) power plant, which has been shut since December 1996, due to design problems that raised safety concerns.
Maine Yankee's board decided in May to suspend current repair work on the unit while they looked for a possible buyer.
PECO Energy in Philadelphia, after spending several weeks mulling a purchase, last week concluded that the plant was not worth buying.
David Flanagan, chairman of the Maine Yankee board, said the company is "committed to a safe and orderly decommissioning.

"A key regulatory step will be taken tomorrow when Maine Yankee expects to submit written certification to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission that the plant has ceased operation and that fuel has been removed from the reactor."

The Entergy Corp team of engineers sent to the site in February to help get the plant back up and running is expected to remain "to shepherd the decommissioning process at least through March, 1998," the company said.
The decision to close the plant ends a career that began in 1972, when it entered commercial operation.
Over the past 25 years Maine Yankee produced 119 billion kilowatt hours of electricity, meeting about one-fourth of Maine's total power demand.
